descriptions.skill: Runtime-driven revision review — a single verifier role settles the fate of every open prior finding against the revised artifact under a deterministic runtime. Dispatched by /gauntlet on a re-review of a posted pull request; not invoked directly. Requires Node >= 22.

roles.verifier: Revision verifier that rules each prior gauntlet finding resolved, persisting, or withdrawn against the revised tree and the pull-request thread, citing where it looked. Runs only inside the revision-review skill's runtime-driven handshake, in a fresh isolated dispatch — never invoked standalone.
